mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0% and remains above this level for two consecutive months, it signals restrictive monetary policy that dampens corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.0 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential construction permits (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 0.1% monthly growth thresholds indicates robust consumer demand and housing market strength, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both increase > 0.1% from t-2mo to t-1mo
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST and RSAFS both increase > 0.1% from t-2mo to t-1mo, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.5%), tight labor markets increase wage pressures and corporate labor costs, compressing profit margins and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE < 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) relative to its 12-month moving average indicates strong manufacturing activity and capacity utilization, supporting corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO increases for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When residential construction permits (HOUST) fall below 1400.0 thousand units, it signals a housing market slowdown that reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST < 1400.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high industrial production growth regime (INDPRO > 115.0), strong manufacturing output boosts corporate revenue and profit visibility, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO > 115.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) relative to its 12-month moving average signals labor market tightening that increases corporate wage costs, compressing earnings and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
